description: Draw a gauge (speedometer dial) for one value between a minimum and a maximum, e.g. a score of 72 out of 100. For a percentage as a filled shape use generate_liquid_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

value.description: The value the needle points at.

name: generate_gauge_chart
title: Gauge
